question: The 14th Sirarakhong Hathei Chilli Festival, held in Sirarakhong Village, celebrates a unique crop from which state?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Manipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• 14th Sirarakhong Hathei Chilli Festival Celebrates Manipur’s GI-Tagged Crop.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
The **14th Sirarakhong Hathei Chilli Festival** was held in **Sirarakhong Village**, **Ukhrul district**, **Manipur**, celebrating the **GI-tagged** Hathei chilli.

 
 
• 
 
The festival promotes the **distinct aroma** and **vibrant red color** of the chilli, boosting its recognition across India.

 
 
• 
 
**Cultural performances**, a **buyer-seller meet**, and a **tree plantation drive** were key activities of the event.

 
 
• 
 
The festival focuses on promoting **agri-tourism**, providing **market linkages** for farmers, and encouraging **environmental conservation**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Manipur**: Established on **21 January 1972**, its capital is **Imphal**, and the official language is **Meitei**. It is known for its rich culture and biodiversity.

 
 
• 
 
**Geographical Indication (GI) Tag**: A special recognition for products originating from a specific region, ensuring their uniqueness and protecting their identity.
